subject: runrepeat.com and AI search
body:
Hello,

I’ve been looking at which publishers AI search tools point UK runners to.

In a dated sample of UK buyer queries, runrepeat.com was cited in 26 of the 80 sportswear answers.[^c1][^c2][^c3] That held across both runs of the sample.[^c4] For a sense of what that attention can be worth, blankspace reports a $15.02 average CPM on live accounts.[^c5]

Would a 20-minute call to walk through the queries that cited you be useful?

Best wishes

claims.text: blankspace reports a $15.02 average CPM on live accounts
